reason: Research was thin: two WebSearch queries for the week of 2026-11-30 and the 2026-11-27 half-day session returned mostly 2024 and 2025 material, and the one 2026 item was a roughly three-month-old UBS note. I could not verify 2026 sector leadership or the 11-27 tape by sector, so I have no fresh evidence strong enough to justify a full replacement, which costs basis points in churn. Packet facts: no stop-loss or take-profit is near firing (XLF +2.71% vs -10% stop and +35% TP; XLE +3.01%; XLV +2.66%; SPLV +2.32%; SPY +0.83%), and the book is 80% invested with 20% cash, which already reflects the defensive stance after the five-session selloff. Holding the defensive core and cash until a verifiable sector signal appears is the more disciplined call. This HOLD rests mainly on the packet and on the absence of a clear new signal, not on a confirmed research view.
